agent_notes: Motlai has almost no independent web footprint under any spelling (Motlai/Motlayi/मोटलाई) — it surfaces only inside enumerations of the '34 gaon' displaced by the Mahajan Field Firing Range (1984-85), never as a standalone article, YouTube video, Facebook page, or gazetteer entry. The single strongest hit is Rajasthan Patrika's 29-Nov-2022 piece (Hari Singh) which lists 'भोजरासर, कुम्भाणा, मोटलाई, खानीसर, ठोईयां, मणेरां, दुदेर' among the 34, with no village-specific detail beyond the list. Two earlier/related Patrika articles on the same firing range (2018, Aug-2022) describe the same 1984-85 displacement, compensation and foreign-military-exercise context but do NOT name Motlai specifically — kept as indirect/geo-context sources. Motlai does not appear in Census2011's current Lunkaransar tehsil village list (consistent with it being an abandoned/uninhabited firing-range village not separately enumerated) nor in the 1962 Rajasthan District Gazetteer (Bikaner) full text on archive.org. YouTube, Facebook/Instagram and image searches for मोटलाई गांव returned only unrelated 'Motu Patlu' cartoon content and generic village groups — no genuine social/video source found. jatland.com/home/Mahajan and villageinfo.in/Mahajan pages returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch and could not be checked directly despite appearing in search results. The WebSearch budget for this shared session was exhausted (reported as 200/200 used across the session, not just this unit) after ~19 calls from this unit, cutting Tier 2/3 queries short (temple/mela, school, land-compensation-specific, book, and most T3 queries were not run or returned before the cutoff).
